groups.name: Breaks the policy
groups.means: An import your policy forbids: one layer or component using another it may not, or a module matching a pattern nothing may match.
groups.todo: Remove the import, or change the policy if the dependency is intended.

groups.name: Import cycle
groups.means: Modules that import each other in a loop, so none can be understood or changed alone.
groups.todo: Break the loop: move the shared piece out, or invert one import.

groups.name: Orphan
groups.means: A module no other module imports that is not an entry point. When only test files import it, the card says so.
groups.todo: If it is dead, delete it. If only tests use it, move it next to them. If a tool or user runs it, list it under entry points.

groups.name: Unused exports
groups.means: A module exports names that no other module imports. A name only a test file imports still counts as unused.
groups.todo: Remove the export, or keep it if code outside this repository uses it.

groups.name: Private imports
groups.means: A Python file imports names another module marks private, by an underscore or by leaving them out of its __all__.
groups.todo: Check whether the name is meant to be public.

groups.name: Long functions
groups.means: A function or method is more than 20 lines, over the length Clean Code says a function should hardly ever reach.
groups.todo: Check whether it does more than one thing.

groups.name: Duplicated code
groups.means: The same structure written more than once; a fix in one copy can miss the others.
groups.todo: Extract the shared part once the copies are truly the same, largest first.

groups.name: C.R.A.P.
groups.means: A function that is both complex and poorly covered by tests, so changing it is risky.
groups.todo: Add tests for it, or simplify it; either lowers the score.

groups.name: Mutations
groups.means: Recognizer changed this function's code and no test failed, so the tests do not pin its behaviour.
groups.todo: Add a test that fails when this function's behaviour changes.

groups.name: Over a limit
groups.means: A measure passed a limit set in your config, such as module size.
groups.todo: Bring it back under the limit, or raise the limit if it is wrong.
